_readme: Qualitative rotation rules. 'status: needs_citation' means the rule is standard agronomy but has not yet been tied to a specific OMAFRA page. min_gap_years = years that must pass before the same crop returns to a field (0 = may repeat). Pest-break notes feed the pest-break rating. Cover crops are handled separately under cover_crops.

corn.note: Corn after corn is allowed but flagged: higher rootworm and disease pressure, lower yield.

soybean.note: Frequent soybean raises soybean cyst nematode and disease risk.

winter_wheat.note: Wheat after wheat raises disease risk (e.g. take-all).

red_clover.note: Short repeat intervals raise disease build-up in clover.

legume_credit.rule: If the previous year's crop was a legume and the current crop is not, drop the current crop's nitrogen-demand class by one level (high -> medium -> low).

cereal_rye.note: Planted after harvest, before the next spring crop.

red_clover.note: Underseeded into winter wheat in early spring, then terminated before the next crop.

corn.note: Breaks the rootworm cycle after a non-corn year.

soybean.note: Cereals and corn break soybean cyst nematode cycles.

winter_wheat.note: Wheat after corn raises fusarium risk from corn residue.
